$schema_description: Declarative 2026 GST statutory compliance rules (CDA). Standard: Indian GST / CGST Act 2017, e-invoicing mandates effective 2026. Consumed by backend RuleEngine (backend/src/RuleEngine.cpp). Rules are data — editing this file never requires recompiling the binary.

$condition_dsl.semantics: For every rule, condition evaluates as a VIOLATION predicate: TRUE => rule violated, a gap is raised and (for INPUT_TEXT rules) the message_template is streamed to the user. FALSE => rule passes.

checks.field: dot.path.into.extracted.document OR state matrix field (e.g. invoice.place_of_supply)
checks.values: allowed-token-lengths list, used by op=token_length_out (a violation fires when the string token's length is OUTSIDE the set)
checks.value_from: cross-field reference: compare 'field' against another path instead of a literal (used by op=ne_cross)

checks.groups: A check may instead be a nested composite {operator:'AND'|'OR', checks:[...]} with no 'field'; it is evaluated recursively and counts as one check. Used to express grouped conditions, e.g. R-CLASS-007 flags a missing buyer GSTIN only when the classification is not B2C.

rule_level.when: optional single precondition check; the whole rule is SKIPPED (passes) when false. Example: {"field":"invoice.irn_present","op":"eq_true"}

rules.summary: Mandatory e-invoicing for AATO exceeding INR 5 Crore.
rules.message_template: The aggregate annual turnover provided is INR {aato_crore} Crore, which exceeds the statutory threshold. Electronic invoicing is therefore MANDATORY. Please supply the 64-character Invoice Registration Number (IRN) obtained from the IRP, or confirm an exemption under Rule 48(4) of the CGST Rules.

rules.summary: E-invoiced transactions must be reported on the IRP within the mandatory 30-day window.
rules.message_template: This e-invoiced transaction must be reported on the Invoice Registration Portal within 30 days of invoice date. No IRP reporting timestamp was captured. Please provide the IRP acknowledgment date (YYYY-MM-DD).

rules.summary: Intra-state supplies must never carry IGST; they must split tax into CGST + SGST.
rules.message_template: The recorded place of supply matches the supplier's state (intra-state), yet the invoice carries IGST. Intra-state supplies must split tax into CGST + SGST (Rule 3, ITC Rules 2017). Please confirm the correct place of supply or tax allocation.

rules.summary: Inter-state supplies must carry IGST only, never CGST + SGST.
rules.message_template: The place of supply differs from the supplier's state (inter-state), yet the invoice carries CGST/SGST. Inter-state supplies must carry IGST only. Please confirm the correct place of supply or tax allocation.

rules.summary: Every HSN code on the invoice must be 4, 6 or 8 digits.

checks.source: thresholds.hsn_min_digits / hsn_max_digits; 8-digit export codes also valid

rules.message_template: Line item {line_index} reports HSN '{hsn}'. Under CGST Notification 01/2026, HSN must be 4, 6 or 8 digits (8-digit codes cover exports and high-turnover filers). Please provide the correct HSN code.

rules.summary: On intra-state invoices, SGST must equal CGST (with matching rates).
rules.message_template: The SGST amount ({sgst}) does not equal CGST ({cgst}) on this intra-state invoice. Please confirm the amounts split across the two heads.

rules.summary: Every invoice must be classified B2B or B2C; an undetermined status -- or a B2B/unknown supply that lacks a buyer GSTIN -- is a gap requiring user input. Legitimate B2C sales (no buyer GSTIN) are never flagged.
rules.message_template: This transaction needs classification input: it is undetermined, or a B2B/unknown supply lacks the buyer's GSTIN. Is the buyer registered under GST? Provide the buyer GSTIN (B2B) or confirm the supply classification.
